notes: Only claims explicitly scoped below are supported; original editions/final independent review still pending.

sources.title: Pascal, Traité du triangle arithmétique, archival French text
Bibliothèque nationale de France CCFr catalog, 1665 Paris printing
University of Warwick, Yang Hui triangle and Jia Xian

claims.statement: Pascal Traité du triangle arithmétique was developed around 1654 and printed posthumously in 1665
claims.limitations: The exact drafting phase 1653 vs 1654 remains debated

claims.statement: Pascal systematically studied the triangle, combinations, stake division and binomial powers
claims.limitations: No claim that Pascal first invented the triangle

claims.statement: Yang Hui's 1261 mathematics and attribution to Jia Xian precede Pascal; wider traditions also existed
claims.limitations: Original lost Jia Xian source not directly checked

claims.statement: The binomial-coefficient recurrence C(n,k)=C(n-1,k)+C(n-1,k-1) follows from include/exclude partition
Sum of n-th row equals 2^n and matches binary sequence count
claims.limitations: Requires 2 outcomes for binary sequence model; no equal probability required for raw count

claims.statement: C(6,2)=15 and C(10,3)=120 are independently verified
claims.limitations: Probability C(n,k)/2^n needs independent fair binary steps

claims.statement: In modern equal independent two-player illustration with remaining 2 vs 3 wins, chance ratio is 11/16 vs 5/16
